The sequel to Insanity.

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Doors could be useful. Having them does no harm.

I've given tame wool room gear on my CTW maps, because I like it when CTW maps last longer and aren't rushed in five minutes. Getting out of the wool room should be a challenge, and not a kill farm.
